name: @8bitscript/examples
description: The example programs that ship with the toolchain: hello-world, the 0.2.0 goal program, and joystick, the controller test app — listed in the editor's launcher beside your own projects.

hello-world.title: Hello, World
hello-world.description: screen.blank() then text.print(0, "Hello World!") through the portable screen and text packages. The 0.2.0 goal program, and the one this toolchain is built to run first — on the PET and in the browser.

joystick.title: Joystick
joystick.description: The controller test app: a labelled map of everything @8bitscript/input exposes — UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, CONFIRM, CANCEL — with a lamp on each that flashes when that control is pressed, a running count of every press seen, and a frame counter that says the loop is live. Run it first on a machine whose input layer is new or suspect.
